note: Threats aimed at the company using AI. Assessed as risks with controls; the lab does not generate synthetic media or phishing.

register.title: Deepfake executive instructs a payment
register.what: A cloned voice or video of a senior person asks staff to move money or share data urgently.

controls.label: Call-back on a known number before any payment change
Dual approval above a set amount

register.title: Deepfake identities at onboarding
register.what: Generated documents and faces pass identity verification to open accounts or claims.

register.title: Cloned voice defeats voice authentication
register.what: A few seconds of public audio is enough to imitate a customer on a phone line that trusts voiceprints.

controls.label: Extra checks on high-risk call requests

register.title: AI-written, personalised phishing at scale
register.what: Fluent, tailored lures in any language, produced cheaply and in volume.

register.title: AI-accelerated vulnerability discovery
register.what: Attackers use AI to find and weaponise flaws in exposed systems faster than patch cycles assume.

controls.label: Shorter patch deadlines for exploited, internet-facing flaws

register.title: Unreviewed AI-generated code reaches production
register.what: Code written by assistants ships without the review and testing human code gets.

controls.label: Human review required for AI-generated changes
Static analysis and dependency checks in CI
Mark AI-generated changes so they can be found later
